text:
emma: quick check-in on the tiny-preview + reorder keyboard flow. want to lock down copy and a11y before design handoff. (thread_ts=1912345678)

rafael: drop it here. short bullets pls.

emma: main changes: 1) replace 'Simulate' with 'Preview rules', 2) add tiny dropdown on Preview for sample sizes (1 / 10 / 50), 3) inline chevrons for keyboard reorder + Alt+Arrow support, 4) clearer validation hints with examples.

cory: love that. microcopy: button -> "Preview rules"; dropdown items -> "Preview 1", "Preview 10", "Preview 50". tooltip: "Runs rules against sample traffic".

zara: accessibility: ensure dropdown reads "Preview 50 samples" to SRs. and the preview button should have aria-describedby pointing to the tooltip text.

emma: reorder: chevrons visible on hover for mouse, always focusable for keyboard. keyboard moves: Alt+Up / Alt+Down. after move announce polite aria-live: "Moved 'Block spam emails' to position 2 of 8".

cory: for the announcement, include the rule title and new ordinal. also restore focus to the moved row.

rafael: undo pattern: show toast "Moved 'X' to #2" with inline [Undo]. undo reverts order and returns focus. keep undo window 6s.

zara: validation copy: replace vague "invalid" with "Condition format error 1: expected 'attribute operator value' e.g., user.email contains 'acme.com'". include small monospace example under the field.

cory: for auto-suggest, show a small button "Suggest fix" next to the validation. if user accepts, tag the change with "auto-suggested" and expose undo.

emma: preview errors: differentiate timeout vs parse errors. copy: "Preview timed out 1: try smaller sample (10) or check rule complexity" and "Preview failed: invalid condition in rule 3" with a link to help. also capture telemetry preview_failure.type = "timeout|parse".

rafael: UI behavior: move chevrons hidden for pinned/system rules; show subtle "system" badge instead. if user attempts drag, show toast "This rule is pinned by policy and cannot be moved."

zara: color contrast: warning chips need darker text at 14px. filing a11y ticket with color tokens.

cory: small dev note: preview-runner API already accepts sample_size and rule_ids. example payload: { "rule_ids": ["r_1","r_7"], "sample_size": 10 }

emma: analytics events: preview_run (size), rule_reorder (method=keyboard|mouse), reorder_undo, preview_failure (type).

zara: keyboard focus order: when preview drawer opens keep focus inside drawer but allow escape to close. do not trap focus if user toggles dock mode.

cory: accessibility-bot: ran quick checklist: ensure aria-labels on chevrons, aria-live polite region for reorder & preview completion, descriptive tooltips, focus management confirmed.

emma: awesome. i'll update Figma frames with the exact copy & keyboard spec and tag you all. aim to open PR early next week.

accessibility-bot: a11y scan recommended a keyboard focus outline color change for high contrast mode. ticket #A11Y-291 created.

rafael: thanks all — small follow-ups in PR review. :rocket:
